bio: Paige Cognetti (née Gebhardt; born August 27, 1980) is an American politician who is the U.S. representative-elect for Pennsylvania's 8th congressional district. Since 2020, she has been the mayor of Scranton, Pennsylvania. Cognetti is Scranton's first woman mayor and won her seat in a special election.
